prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1052; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported knee trauma, and the presenting symptoms are plausible for an impact of this kind. Over the course of 18 visits, care included physical examination, imaging, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the knee injury. The patient's history includes a small strain to the same region many years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency and intensity decreasing steadily as strength, mobility, and pain improved. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges. At the most recent evaluation, the patient was progressing well and was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
